title: CRG-* items
summary: Chainrings family inventory covering CRG-38 and CRG-42 stock levels across Manchester and Leeds warehouse locations.
body:
The `CRG-*` item family comprises chainrings utilized in Northbridge Cycles assembly and replacement stock. As of 09:00 on 26 October 2026, active tracked inventory includes models CRG-38 and CRG-42 across warehouse facilities [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock_on_hand_2026-10-26_0900]][^r1][^r2].

## Stock on hand

Inventory levels recorded at 09:00 GMT on 26 October 2026 are:

* **CRG-38**: At WH-MAN-STR, there are 4 on hand, 1 allocated, and 10 on order[^r1].
* **CRG-42**: At WH-MAN-STR, there are 8 on hand, 0 allocated, and 10 on order[^r2]. At WH-LDS-STR, there are 5 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order[^r2].

Warehouse stock movements and current balances are tracked through [[services-pur-stk|PUR stk services]] and reported in the [[data-stock-on-hand|stock master data]][^r1][^r2].
